review.why: Designs revenue operations: lifecycle stages, MQL and SQL definitions, lead scoring, routing, handoff SLAs, pipeline stages, CRM automation and metrics.
review.summary: Sets principles (one source of truth, define before automate, measure every handoff), then lifecycle stages with owners and an MQL rule needing both fit and engagement, a scoring model with negative scoring and a held-out test, routing methods, pipeline stage hygiene, CRM automations, deal desk tiers, data hygiene and a metrics dashboard.
strengths: MQL needs fit and engagement, with a response SLA for each handoff
Scoring model is tested on a later holdout, not just tuned to past data
Output is standalone documents ready to implement
cautions: Speed-to-lead and benchmark figures are quoted without full sources
Aimed at B2B software with a CRM
Playbooks and templates are in five files not read here
